messages:
maria g.: Quick sync — prepping GTM on‑page handoff for next week's webinar + benchmark post. Need canonical + redirect map, keyword clusters, schema snippet, and inbound lead routing plan. Who can own each?
raj: I can own keyword clusters and anchors. Will share an initial CSV today.
becca: I’ll do canonical/redirect mapping. Can we avoid creating a new /blog/ redirect storm? prefer mapping to /resources/ or the webinar landing.
tom (growth): I’ll handle inbound routing & UTM plan. Need form field names and webhook destination. @maria g. which campaign ID for webinar?
maria g.: campaign id is rw-webinar-2026-03. Webhook → Pardot (webhook URL in growth creds). Form fields: name, email, company, role, intent (dropdown).
seo-bot: quick audit: found 12 live pages with same meta title pattern that could cannibalize webinar terms. Recommend canonical consolidation to landing page + 301s for stale blog posts.
ellie: can you paste sample redirect mapping format? will pass to eng for the PR review.
becca: sample mapping below — using the format eng prefers for netlify/_redirects style:
```
/old-benchmark-analysis 301 /resources/benchmark-report  
/blog/old-webinar-preview 301 /events/webinar-march-2026  
/product/deep-dive 301 /resources/product-deep-dive  
```
raj: keyword clusters (high level) — list: 
- inference cost reduction (primary)
- low-latency llm serving
- private llm deployment options
- dedicated inference capacity
Anchors to use: "inference cost", "low-latency serving", "private deployment"
maria g.: For internal linking: add contextual links from existing product docs and benchmarks to the webinar landing and the benchmark post. Prioritize pages with >200 monthly sessions.
seo-bot: schema suggestion for webinar landing (JSON-LD snippet):
```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Webinar — Serving LLMs in Production",
  "startDate": "2026-03-18T16:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-03-18T17:00:00Z",
  "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled",
  "organizer": {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference"},
  "url": "https://www.redwood.inference/events/webinar-march-2026"
}
```
tom (growth): routing checklist: 
- landing form -> Pardot webhook (tag: rw-webinar-2026)
- utm_source=webinar_email / utm_medium=email / utm_campaign=rw-webinar-2026
- thank-you page triggers SFDC lead creation via zapier (we have zap config id zap-88)
maria g.: Small prioritization: 1) canonical/301 plan (becca) 2) inbound routing + form (tom) 3) keyword cluster + anchors (raj) 4) schema + meta (seo-bot) 5) internal linking list (ellis)
ellie: I’ll compile the internal linking list from GA4 and send a sheet. ETA EOD.
becca: will draft redirect PR with explanations and a rollback plan. Will flag any URLs that lose external backlinks for manual review.
raj: posting rough meta descriptions to the doc now — short, keyword-focused, and A/B-ready for the benchmark post.
maria g.: Excellent. Let's reconvene tomorrow 11am PT to review the final handoff doc and the PR. :thumbsup:
tom (growth): added routing checklist to the shared Notion page and included webhook sample.
seo-bot: reminder — run the staging crawl after PR is merged and check for mixed canonicals.
ellie: noted. See you all tomorrow.
